scope: Displayed real-Qwen gradient measurements and synthetic arithmetic RL results only. No new training launched. Seed-42 success is not a consistent cross-seed advantage. Batch-512 follow-up has no completed endpoint in this checked snapshot.

qwen_sampler_target.configuration: lag4 FP32, eight SST-2 A/B prompts, four responses per group, all 752393024 text parameters, engine batch one
qwen_sampler_target.target: E[q^4] mean(A_i score_q_i); sample-standardized group advantages ddof=1, epsilon=1e-6
qwen_sampler_target.aggregation: Arithmetic mean of conditional per-prompt bias², variance or MSE divided by that prompt’s inference-reference target norm²; eight fixed SST-2 prompts, not a population estimate.
limitations: Restricted two-action task; not full-vocabulary multi-token generation.
Per-action IS does not change the joint advantage distribution; TIS and IS are comparative estimators, not unbiased g_q estimators.
The shared-context centering term cancels within each group.
TIS cap2 never activates in these lag4 measurements.

precision_variance.definition: Ratios of mean absolute A/B conditional group-gradient variances across eight prompts; all statistical batches rescale by the same factor.

configuration.quantization: Deterministic round-to-nearest symmetric absmax per output-row input-group of 128. qmax=2^(bits-1)-1, codes in [-qmax,qmax]. Linear weights except lm_head; norms, embeddings, convolutions and activations remain FP32. Dequantized weights execute FP32 kernels. NOT a native INT kernel, calibrated GPTQ/AWQ, or speed benchmark.
configuration.limitations: Full-vocabulary metrics concern forward distributions and importance weights, NOT full-parameter gradient variance. Full-parameter estimator variance is evaluated separately for the constrained A/B policy, without claiming a differentiable low-precision q oracle. Same master checkpoint, no checkpoint-lag HVP.

limitations: Weight rounding simulation executes in FP32; not native low-bit inference kernels.

seed42_learning.scope: One seed, new operand range and fixed dataset. Post-hoc subsets are descriptive. This completes only the three-method 30-step study, not the separate long-run matrices.

timing.scope: Read-only reanalysis of completed, paired seed-42, 30-update, batch-64 runs. No training run launched or changed.

formulas.training: sum(perf/actor_train_time for exactly one actor record for each rollout_id 0..29)
formulas.step_time: perf/train_time + perf/train_wait_time; a framework-derived quantity, not the top-level elapsed_seconds

actor_train.scope: Wall-clock time of model.train(...) block, including before-step reference hook (and first-call lazy ReferenceState initialization), all 64 forward/backward microbatches, correction/reference diagnostics, optimizer and scheduler update, and training logging. Excludes rollout generation/evaluation and main engine/model initialization as directly called stages, but concurrent worker contention is part of elapsed time.

train.scope: Outer timer additionally includes advantage/return computation, rollout-data postprocess and logging.

clock.scope: time.time elapsed, not isolated CUDA-event kernel timing. No explicit device synchronize in timer itself; training metric .item() calls and reference diagnostics perform synchronization during block.

perf_reset.scope: Reports timer values then resets each training update; perf/step_time adds train_wait to train.

end_to_end.scope: Starts before ray.init, includes training/rollout model init, rollout, weight transfers, evaluation, training and diagnostics; final time recorded after train(args) returns and before ray.shutdown. CLI parse and imports precede clock.

loss_hook.scope: diagnostics.jsonl seconds times loss hook only; misses preceding native forward and later backward/optimizer. GRPO original policy_loss_function also occurs after diagnostic timer. Cannot label this train time.

limitations: All values come from one paired seed and 30 updates. This is an instrumented study, not production throughput.
Actor training times include expensive reference/gradient audits and hooks; they do not isolate incremental HVP cost.
Async rollout can overlap actor training. Do not add worker rollout elapsed to actor elapsed to estimate end-to-end runtime.
Neither a pure forward/backward/optimizer breakdown nor diagnostic-free runtime is recorded in these logs.

Core timer/model/actor source files are clean in the vendored Git checkout, but were not individually listed in the run_status source manifest. Their current hashes are captured here; experiment launcher, hook, and vendor/train.py hashes match saved run manifests.

cpu_probe.definition: Single-prompt CPU logit-margin full-parameter gradient basis construction; optional create_graph + one HVP in independent/qwen_fullgrad_20261011/run.py:95-104. Excludes optimizer, sampling, async scheduler and end-to-end training. Different CPU probe/configuration; cannot interpret 3.05x as native training slowdown.

score_transport.target: The negative raw action score at the behavior-policy parameters, computed by differentiating negative log probability there. This is not the current-policy score.
score_transport.measurement: L2 error of reference STE or corrected STE relative to the same behavior-score oracle; residual_fraction is corrected error divided by STE error within one observation.
score_transport.selection: The first microbatch of each update only; fresh update1 omitted. Nonzero-advantage subsets contain 1, 3, and 6 observations. These are not whole-batch gradient errors or independent seeds.
score_transport.interpretation: Within-trajectory counterfactual score comparisons; even the GRPO trajectory diagnostics compare STE and corrected STE scores, not the implemented GRPO loss gradient. Do not compare median error levels across trajectories as if their policies and sampled actions were matched, or infer that local error reduction alone causes the final accuracy difference.

first_informative_stale_group.scope: Descriptive first stale mixed-reward group in the completed seed42 study; methods have the same first three sampled batches. GRPO ratios reconstructed from saved rollout and current native selected log-probabilities, before this update. Gradient norms are for the whole batch. This does not establish a universal cause of collapse, or identify why uncorrectedST later collapses.

completed_seed_qualification.scope: Only fully audited 30-update runs. Seeds, not repeated answers, are replicates. One fixed 20-question test. Freshness controls cover seed 42 only; no general causal claim. AUC is trapezoidal accuracy averaged over 0..30 steps. Partial or unpaired seeds excluded from paired summaries.

qwen_checkpoint_bias.protocol: Real Qwen3.5-0.8B weights, all 752393024 text parameters; eight fixed SST-2 A/B prompts; G=4; CPU FP32 execution, engine batch one; own full-parameter SGD updates at learning rate 1e-5 induce lag. No artificial independent Jacobian/logit perturbations.
qwen_checkpoint_bias.scope: Exact group-standardized update expectation; not raw expected-reward gradient. Real-model controlled gradient experiment, separate from Megatron/SGLang arithmetic training. Two lag checkpoints do not verify asymptotic order.

qwen_gradient_comparison.gradient_scope: all 752393024 Qwen3.5-0.8B text parameters; constrained one-token A/B policy; real checkpoint lag via SGD lr 1e-5; no synthetic Jacobian/logit perturbation
qwen_gradient_comparison.aggregation: Mean across eight fixed prompts of each per-prompt squared metric divided by that prompt reference-target norm squared (g_q for target=g_q; g_p for target=g_p). Conditional prompt metrics, not population-of-prompts results.
qwen_gradient_comparison.target: Exact expected group-advantage updates g_q under q^4 and g_p under p^4; G=4, reward correctness, sample sd ddof1 and epsilon1e-6.

GRPO.ratio: p/q exactly once; q is PPO denominator; no extra duplicate p/q weighting

TIS.weight: min(p/q,2) with detached weights times training score

qwen_gradient_comparison.IS: unclipped_IS uses per-token p/q, not whole-group probability ratio; group advantages mean it is not guaranteed unbiased for g_p.
limits: Each MSE is relative to the target named in its record; target mismatch contributes to errors when a method pursues the other update direction. The target=gp export includes lag4 only.
B=4/16/64/256 means 1/4/16/64 independently sampled groups, engine batch fixed1.
Because one-token responses share the prefix and group advantages sum0, common centering term cancels.
Exact enumeration eliminates Monte Carlo estimation uncertainty; eight prompts remain a small controlled setup.
g_p rows use per-prompt g_p norm² normalization, so normalized g_p/g_q magnitudes cannot be directly compared as absolute errors across panels.
oracle_q is a q-score oracle and is generally biased relative to g_p; do not label it an unbiased oracle in the g_p panel.

paired_seed_learning.scope: Four paired completed 30-update async seeds. Each absolute endpoint read from actual per-run audit.json and cross-checked to complete_run_analysis.json; not reconstructed from pairwise differences.
paired_seed_learning.source_path_correction: Summary record for seed43 GRPO names gpu0, but actual audited run is async_grpo_seed43_gpu1; audit endpoint matches summary. Actual_run preserves verified location.

protocol.data_policy: 9980-question pool; identical ordered960 distinct questions per method; no multi-epoch.
protocol.evaluation: Same fixed20 held-out questions,4 independently seeded sampled answers per question.
protocol.model: Qwen3.5-0.8B, original checkpoint, full text-parameter FP32 training

method_definitions.sc: Existing behavior-score-centered straight-through loss (previously labelled ST).
method_definitions.corrected_sc: Same loss plus first-order HVP transport using each sample actual behavior snapshot.
method_definitions.tis_grpo: Native PPO-clipped GRPO with detached training-policy denominator and vanilla token-level TIS: min(p_anchor/q_behavior,2). Lower bound0, no rejection sampling or batch normalization.

async_settings.rationale: Scale the worker group concurrency from4/16 prompts to8/32 prompts to retain comparable stale-sample exposure. Actual per-sample ages are audited; no assumed age histogram.

protocol.execution: Finish the two retained16x4 jobs, then strictly sequential SC -> corrected SC -> TIS-GRPO.
protocol.interpretation: One seed and one fixed small test set. Do not infer cross-seed robustness or call this a controlled batch-size-only intervention against the old study.

batch512_train_eval.training_metric: Raw correct responses / 512 from the actual rollout batch consumed before each optimizer update, with some stale behavior checkpoints; not a fixed training-set evaluation.
batch512_train_eval.evaluation_metric: Exact-match sampled answers / 80, on the same fixed 20 held-out questions with four draws each.
batch512_train_eval.scope: Single seed 42. Partial DRSC curve; no inferred endpoint. Not a batch-size-only ablation of the prior 16x4 experiment.
